title: mimi-mls wire: decode SemiPrivateMessage, SemiPrivateMessageContent, KeyForExternalReceiver
description: semiprivatemessage-08 §3.1 (txt L229-347); wire format 0x0011 (suggested); strict decoding as for PrivateMessage.
close_reason: Done in 9585b295. mimi-mls::wire::semiprivate decodes SemiPrivateMessage, KeyForExternalReceiver, ExternalReceiverRef, SemiPrivateContentAAD and SemiPrivateMessageContent per semiprivatemessage-08 §3.1, with 12 hand-encoded wire fixtures. The frame refuses application(1) and an unknown content type; MAX_EXTERNAL_RECEIVERS = 64 is INVENTED since the draft bounds the list not at all; the content's padding must be zero (RFC 9420 §6.3.2). Both invented refusals verified red when disabled. Needed exporting CommitIn and FramedContentAuthData from openmls (branch mimid-0.9.2 at 64f9eab2f, proposed upstream as openmls/openmls#2351); ProposalIn was already public. Gates green, 2193 tests.
